statements.impact_statement: The advisory is a CSRF in react-router's RSC (React Server Components) mode. apps/web is a client-side Vite single-page app on react-router-dom 7.x and never enables RSC mode, so the vulnerable request handling is never executed. The entry is removed when react-router reaches a patched release (>=8.3.0).

The advisory is a denial of service through unbounded precision specifiers in a format string. sprintf-js is reached only through the optional search runtime (@huggingface/transformers > onnxruntime-node > global-agent > roarr), whose format strings are library-internal constants, never user input. No patched sprintf-js is published; the entry is removed when one is, or when that dependency path goes away.
